contexts.text: Bread from wheat (in the most ancient time).
The more noble species of good are signified by wheat and barley Illustrated.
Reuben went in the days of wheat-harvest () = faith as to its state of love and charity... for wheat love and charity.
That wheat = the things which are of love and charity. Illustrated.
Wheat () = celestial love; barley, spiritual love. ( = interior and exterior good. AC 7602.)
A measure of wheat for a penny () = that love is so rare. ( = the estimation of good... almost none at all. AR 315.) ( = the genuine good of the Church of no account. AE 374.)
Gather the wheat into my barn () = the goods. ( = those interiorly good. LJ 70:2. LJCont 10:end.)
The wheat and the rye () = the good of the interior Natural, and its truth. (Were not smitten = were not destroyed. AC 7606.)
For wheat = the good of love and of charity; and, as it is a more noble kind of corn than barley is = the good of the interior Natural.
Wheat and barley = goods. AC 10303:2.
Wheat = good; and fine flour, its truth.
With fine flour of wheat shalt thou make them () = the truth which is from Divine good, from which these things are... For wheat = the good of love; thus, in the supreme sense, the Divine good.
= The seed of wheat, or of barley = states of good.
Wheat and barley in the ear = good receiving and also received.
Wheat = the good of love of the internal man.
Seeds like the grains of Chinese wheat (seen in the Fifth Earth).

The reason wheat and barley = good and truth; here, the good and truth of the Church from the Word, is that all things of the field and vineyard = such things as are of the Church... AR 794. AE 374:2, Further explained.
That wheat and barley = the good and truth of the Church. Illustrated. AE 374.
(No) wheat () = no... worship from celestial good. ( = profaned worship from the goods which are from a spiritual origin. AE 1153.)
Like wheat in a winnowing shovel.
As when wheat... is thrown to the dogs...
The wheat (in the parable of the tares) = the truths and goods of a new Church. ( = the good of truth, and therefore those who are in good through truths. AE 374:15). AE 397:2. AE 426:3. AE 624:3.

They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns () = to take truths of good from the Word and turn them into falsities of evil. ( = that instead of the goods of truth there are evils of falsity. AE 374:5.)
The fat of the kidneys of wheat () = genuine good. ( = all good in general. AE 374:10.)

He satisfieth thee with the fat of wheat () = with all good of love and with wisdom; fat = the good of love; and wheat = all things which are from the good of love; in special, the truths of Heaven and the derivative wisdom. AE 374:12.
Wheat = the good of the Church in general. (See Barley.)
Wheat () = the good of the natural man.
I would feed them with the fat of wheat () = with good of every kind from celestial good... For fat = celestial good; and wheat, good of every kind. ( = the delight of spiritual good. AE 619:10.)
He will gather the wheat into the garner () = good of every kind that is from a heavenly origin which He will preserve to eternity.
Wheat = the good of the Church in general, thus that which is in the sense of the letter. (Continued. See Barley.)
Wheats of Minnith and Pannag () = truths and goods of the Church of every kind.
As a faith of falsity is like chaff before the wind, it is said... that (Satan) might sift them as wheat (); wheat = the good of charity separated from the chaff.

Lest while ye gather up the tares ye root up the wheat together with them () = that truth from good and its increase would also perish; for, with the men of the Church, truths are intermingled with falsities, and the truths cannot be separated, and the falsities cast out, until the men have been reformed. Let both grow together until the harvest; and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers... gather the wheat into my barn = ... that (in the last state of the Church) the falsities of evil are separated from the truths of good... and these are conjoined with Heaven; or, what is the same, the men who are in them. These things take place in the Spiritual World...
Were ashamed, and howled... for the wheat and for the barley () = grief on account of the devastation of good and truth.
Wheat = good; and fine flour, its truth.
Wheat = the good of love; and fine flour, the truth from this good.
